title: Scheduled Batches
description: Schedule batch jobs by checking the Scheduled checkboxes on the Batch Job Scheduler Configuration page. When jobScheduleNames is omitted, all checkboxes are checked.

jobScheduleNames.title: Job Names
jobScheduleNames.description: Optional. List of batch job names to schedule (matches the Job Name column in the table). When omitted, all checkboxes are checked.

allJobScheduleNames.title: All Job Names
allJobScheduleNames.description: Optional. If true, all batch job names are scheduled. Overrides jobScheduleNames.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Optional. The namespace of the batch job schedule object. Defaults to 'th_dev'.
